title: works ok
text: works ok. This paper towel holder is weighted at the base and you must remove the screw on top to place/replace the papertowel roll. The idea that it is allows you to tear "one towel" at a time, is kind of true.  But you must use two hands.  It is sort of "spring" loaded and does prevent a free for all spin, so that's good. I wish I would have gotten one that you slide the roll over the top instead of one that you have to unscrew the top piece to load.  It works.  If it's important to you.. the red is a deep, not bright red... more toward a burgundy, but not quite.  Hope that helps!

product_metadata.title: Kamenstein Perfect Tear Paper Towel Holder, Dark Red
features: PERFECT TEAR TECHNOLOGY: The holder's patented 'Perfect Tear Technology' features an ingenious ratchet system that prevents rolls from unraveling.
EASY TO TEAR AND USE: The weighted base allows you to enjoy simple, one-handed operation; just pull and tear with perfect results every time.
DESIGNED TO FIT ANY SIZE ROLL: The interior wire roller is designed to fit any size roll, even jumbo sized rolls.
REPLACE PAPER TOWELS EASILY: In most cases, paper towel rolls simple slide on and off the roller, without having to remove the finial.
RUST-RESISTANT STAINLESS STEEL: This paper towel holder is constructed from rust-resistant stainless steel and measures at 13-inches tall.
description: The Kamenstein Perfect Tear Paper Towel Holder keeps your paper towels from unraveling and helps you tear off just the amount you need. This paper towel holder is designed to neatly tear paper towels along the perforation. The towel holder boasts rust-resistant stainless steel construction. The paper towel holder’s weighted base and nonskid feet provide increased stability. This holder accommodates both regular and jumbo-sized paper towel rolls. This paper towel holder measures 12 inches high and weighs approximately 4 pounds.
